source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 11.7.1 (Structure of Alkenes) with Figures 11.8 to 11.10, printed pages 256-257.

blocks.text: Ethene, C2H4, sab se saada alkene hai. Ethene mein har carbon atom sp2 hybridised hai aur ek hi satah (plane) mein teen barabar sp2 hybrid orbitals banata hai; ghair-hybridised p orbital hybrid orbitals ki satah par amoodi (90 degrees) hai (Figure 11.8). sp2 orbitals 2s orbital ko do 2p orbitals se mila kar bante hain, ek ghair-hybridised p orbital chhorte hue. Ethene mein har carbon do sp2 orbitals do C-H bonds banane mein istemal karta hai, aur har carbon ka baqi sp2 orbital seedhe (linear) overlap se carbon-carbon sigma bond banata hai (Figure 11.9). Dono carbons ke ghair-hybridised p orbitals, jo ek doosre ke mutawazi (parallel) hain, pehloo se (laterally) overlap kar ke ek aur carbon-carbon bond banate hain, pi bond.

blocks.alt: Carbon atom jis ke teen naranji sp2 hybrid orbitals aik chapti plane mein 120 degree ke fasle par phaile hain (perspective mein), aur aik hara unhybridised 2p orbital jis ke lobes plane ke oopar aur neeche us se 90 degree par hain. Dabba kehta hai 2s, 2px aur 2py mil kar teen sp2 orbitals banate hain aur 2pz bach jata hai.
blocks.caption: Carbon ke sp2 hybrid aur unhybrid p orbitals (Figure 11.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Halki chapti plane par ethene: do carbon C-C axis ke saath jamni sigma bond se jure, har carbon par do hydrogen naranji sigma bonds se taqreeban 120 degree par. Har carbon se hare 2p orbital lobes oopar neeche khare hain, aur plane ke oopar aur neeche do hare badal unhein jorte hain: yahi pi bond hai.
blocks.caption: Ethene mein carbons ke darmiyan bond banna (sigma aur pi bonds) (Figure 11.9 ke mutabiq asal 3D model; ghuma kar har taraf se dekhein).
blocks.long_description: Ethene ka har carbon sp2 hai. Us ke teen sp2 orbitals aik plane mein 120 degree par hain aur end-on overlap se sigma bonds banate hain: aik C-C aur do C-H. Unhybridised 2p orbitals is plane par amudi (90 degree) khare hain aur plane ke oopar aur neeche pehlu ba pehlu (sideways) overlap kar ke pi bond banate hain. Pi bond molecule ko chapta rakhta hai aur C=C ke gird ghoomne nahi deta.

blocks.text: Double bond banane wale do carbon atoms aur un se seedhe jure chaar atoms ek hi satah mein hain. sp2 hybridisation har carbon ke gird trigonal planar tarteeb deti hai jis ke bond angles taqreeban 120 degrees hain, to ethene ek chapta (planar) molecule hai (Figure 11.10).

blocks.alt: Chapta ethene: do carbons double bond (aik sigma, aik pi) se jure, har carbon par do hydrogen, aur H-C-H zaviya taqreeban 120 degree. Note kehta hai har carbon sp2 hai aur pi bond C=C ke gird ghoomne nahi deta.

blocks.prompt: Ethene molecule ki shakal us ke sigma aur pi C-C bonds ke lihaz se wazeh karein.
blocks.explanation: Har carbon apne 2s ko do 2p orbitals se mila kar ek satah mein 120 degrees par teen sp2 orbitals banata hai, jo do C-H bonds aur C-C sigma bond ke liye istemal hote hain; bache hue p orbitals us satah par amoodi khare hain aur pehloo se overlap kar ke pi bond banate hain. Kyunke pi bond ko p orbitals mutawazi chahiye, chhe ke chhe atoms ek satah mein jakre hain: chapta, trigonal planar molecule.

items: Ethene: har C sp2 (2s + do 2p), 120 degrees par teen planar hybrids, 90 degrees par ek p orbital; C=C = sigma (sp2-sp2 linear overlap) + pi (lateral p-p overlap); planar molecule.
